title: Director - Media Planning & Strategy
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Strategy and Long-Term Planning

The Director defines and owns the Media Planning team's long-range strategy, ensuring it is aligned with DMN's commercial objectives, annual OKRs, and the broader commerce media landscape. This includes:

  • Building and maintaining the strategic storytelling frameworks that govern how DMN positions its media products to brand partners, including audience narratives, channel value propositions, and performance proof points.

  • Defining the annual priorities and key results for the Media Planning function, cascading them into team-level goals and tracking progress with rigor throughout the year.

  • Establishing DMN's point of view on emerging media planning trends, audience strategies, measurement methodologies, and competitive positioning, and bringing that perspective into plans and client conversations.

  • Communicating the team's strategic direction and performance to internal leadership on a weekly basis, including flagging risks, surfacing opportunities, and advocating for resources and tooling investments.

People Leadership and Team Development

The Director directly manages a media planning manager, with accountability for the performance, development, and culture of the full media planning team. Responsibilities include:

  • Setting clear performance expectations and development plans for each team member, conducting regular 1:1s and formal reviews, and recognizing and rewarding high performance consistently.

  • Recruiting and onboarding top media planning talent, with an emphasis on candidates who combine strong analytical instincts with the ability to build a compelling narrative around data.

  • Identifying skill gaps across the team and designing or sourcing the training, tools, and experiences needed to close them, with a particular focus on retail and commerce media fluency and storytelling craft.

  • Building a team culture that prizes intellectual rigor, creative problem-solving, and collaborative client service, and that attracts strong talent.

  • Build effective teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals by establishing common objectives and a shared mindset.

  • Manage execution responsibilities and workload of direct/indirect reports to achieve functional deliverables on time and with quality.

  • Develops talent through coaching, feedback, exposure, and stretch assignments in order to meet their own career goals as well as the organization’s priorities

  • Establish strategic staffing and succession plans; successfully deliver on proposed staffing objectives.

  • Drive the talent selection process in alignment with the company’s talent philosophy for open direct/indirect reporting positions; Ensure all direct reports are appropriately trained and on-boarded.

  • Drive engagement by creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives; focus on voice of teammate data (e.g., Engagement & Pulse results), partnering with organization leadership to drive necessary changes.

Media Strategy and Plan Quality

The Director is ultimately accountable for the quality and strategic coherence of every media plan produced by the team. This means:

  • Establishing and enforcing the standard for what a great plan looks like, including how audience data is surfaced, how channel recommendations are structured and justified, how performance projections are modeled, and how the narrative ties objectives to outcomes.

  • Reviewing and providing substantive feedback on plans before they go to clients, ensuring they meet the strategic bar, are free of errors, and are positioned to generate brand confidence and investment.

  • Building reusable planning templates, data-driven benchmarks, and storytelling frameworks that enable planners to work more efficiently and consistently without sacrificing strategic depth.

  • Staying close to brand and category-level trends to ensure plans are informed by what is actually happening in the market, not just by channel inventory and audience availability.

Tooling, Product, and Process Influence

The Director actively shapes how the Media Planning team works by influencing the tools, systems, and workflows available to them. Responsibilities include:

  • Maintaining a clear point of view on what tools and product features would most meaningfully improve the quality and efficiency of the planning process, and advocating for those investments through structured product partnership engagements.

  • Working with product and engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and test new planning capabilities, audience tools, and data visualization features, representing the planner's perspective in the product roadmap process.

  • Establishing standard operating procedures for plan development, approval workflows, version control, and client handoff that scale as the team and portfolio grow.

  • Identifying and eliminating friction in the planning process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

The Director represents the Media Planning function across the organization and ensures it is well-connected to the teams it most closely supports and depends on. This includes:

  • Partnering with Sales and Account Management to ensure plans are produced on the timelines clients need, are responsive to the commercial context of each opportunity, and are positioned to close business and retain investment.

  • Collaborating with Analytics and Reporting to ensure that performance measurement methodologies, attribution approaches, and reporting frameworks are reflected accurately in how plans are built and how expectations are set with clients.

  • Engaging with the Monetization team to ensure that new inventory, audience, and targeting capabilities are understood by the planning team and incorporated into plans as soon as they are available.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • 7 - 10 years with 8+ years of experience in media planning, media strategy, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years in a people management role.

  • Demonstrated ability to build data-informed media strategies and translate quantitative analysis into compelling, accessible narratives that drive executive and client alignment.

  • Deep familiarity with the retail and commerce media landscape, including how sponsored products, onsite display, offsite programmatic, CTV, and social channels operate and how brands evaluate their value.

  • Proven track record of developing media plans that win business and deliver measurable performance outcomes against advertiser objectives.

  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders without direct authority, and building productive working relationships across Sales, Account Management, Analytics, and Product.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to distill complex planning rationale into clear, persuasive narratives for senior audiences

  • Analytical proficiency: comfortable working with audience data, reach and frequency models, performance benchmarks, and campaign measurement methodologies.

  • Preferred prior experience at a retail media network, commerce media platform, or major publisher, with direct exposure to first-party audience data activation and closed-loop measurement.

  • Preferred familiarity with media mix modeling (MMM), multi-touch attribution, and incrementality testing, and the ability to apply those frameworks to how plans are structured and sold.

  • Preferred experience working with or alongside media agencies, with an understanding of how brands and agencies evaluate media investment decisions in a retail media context.

  • Preferred background in media planning tools, audience analytics platforms, or data visualization tools, with a track record of advocating for and adopting technology that improves team output.

About the Role

Engine is looking for a Director of Talent Acquisition Operations to build and orchestrate the infrastructure that powers our hiring. As we scale, we need a leader who can transform our recruitment operations into a high-efficiency machine with AI and automation at the center of how we work. You will own the mechanics of our hiring process, covering everything from the technology stack and AI roadmap to the standard operating procedures that ensure every candidate and recruiter has a low-friction experience.

This is a leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, process design, and hiring strategy. You will be responsible for ensuring our Talent Acquisition Partners are equipped to do their best work, our data is clean, and our systems are ready for the next four quarters of growth. If you are a systems-thinker who loves to automate manual tasks and elevate the human side of recruiting, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Process & Enablement: Design, document, and implement end-to-end SOPs for the entire hiring lifecycle, from position management in our HRIS to final hire in Greenhouse.
  • Hiring Capacity Planning: Build and maintain a rigorous planning and forecasting discipline, including a dynamic Capacity vs. Demand model to ensure the TA organization is right-sized to deliver against headcount goals over the next 2 to 3 quarters.
  • Tech Stack Management: Own the TA tool ecosystem and roadmap. You will manage vendor relationships, drive tool adoption at scale, and ensure our systems are integrated and optimized for long-term growth.
  • Innovation & AI: Develop and execute an AI in Ops roadmap, leveraging emerging technologies to improve talent rediscovery and recruiter productivity.
  • Program Ownership: Lead high-impact TA programs including our Referrals program and Talent Masters, an initiative dedicated to upskilling our recruiters and elevating their strategic capabilities.
  • Candidate Experience: Streamline interview coordination through automation and own the SLAs and templates that define how we communicate with talent.
  • Data & Insights: Own the reporting and analytics for candidate experience and operational health. You will use data to identify bottlenecks and drive quarterly OKRs and "rocks."

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with at least 4 years focused specifically on TA Operations in a fast-paced, high-growth tech environment.
  • Expert-level knowledge of ATS, HRIS, and hiring technology. You know how to configure these tools to drive maximum effectiveness and efficiency.
  • A Systems-First Mindset: You enjoy building documentation and SOPs that are practical, scalable, and intuitive for the team to follow.
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with data and can translate candidate sentiment and funnel metrics into actionable operational improvements.
  • Program Management: You have a proven track record of launching and scaling programs like employee referrals, university hiring, interviewer training, or CRM and Talent Rediscovery initiatives.
  • Future-Focused: You stay ahead of the curve on AI and automation trends within HR Tech and know how to apply them to solve real-world hiring challenges.
  • Collaboration: You have the ability to work cross-functionally with Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to ensure the TA engine is aligned with broader company goals.

Applications for this role will be accepted through May 20th, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About BLEN

BLENers are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems. For over 20 years, we've helped government agencies and businesses transform their digital experience — modernizing legacy systems, building cloud-native applications, and experimenting with what's just around the corner. We value long, enduring partnerships and put humans at the center of every experience. Our team thrives on turning tricky problems into solutions that are practical, accessible, and performant.

About this position

We're hiring an AI Engineer to help our federal and commercial clients ship production-grade applications powered by large language models — with a strong focus on agentic systems and MCP-based integrations.

You'll spend your time building real things: agents that take actions on behalf of users, RAG pipelines that ground answers in trusted sources, and MCP servers that securely connect models to the data and tools our clients already rely on. You'll wire up model APIs, design tool interfaces, build evals, and make sure what we ship is fast, reliable, observable, and safe.

This isn't a research role. You won't be training foundation models. You will be designing and shipping agentic AI systems that real users — including senior government stakeholders — depend on, and you'll have a strong voice in how we adopt generative AI responsibly across our portfolio.

If you get excited about agent design, tool use, MCP, evals, and the weekly firehose of new models and frameworks — and you want that energy pointed at meaningful public-sector work — this is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step agents that plan, call tools, retrieve context, and take action with appropriate human-in-the-loop checkpoints

  • Build MCP servers and clients to securely expose client data, internal tools, and APIs to LLMs in a standardized, auditable way

  • Ship LLM-powered applications: copilots, document intelligence, search, summarization, and workflow automation

  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines — chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval, reranking, and grounding

  • Integrate model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, open-weight models) and pick the right model for the job based on quality, latency, and cost

  • Develop evals and observability for agents and AI features so we know what's working in production and what's regressing

  • Apply prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and guardrails to make agent behavior predictable

  • Write production Python backends and APIs that expose AI capabilities to web and mobile clients

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product folks to scope what AI should (and shouldn't) do in a given product

  • Help shape responsible AI practices for federal use — privacy, security, auditability, and human oversight

Basic qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1 year shipping LLM-based or AI-powered features to production

  • Hands-on experience designing or building agentic systems — tool calling, multi-step reasoning, planning loops, or agent orchestration (LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude tool use, or equivalent)

  • Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — or demonstrated ability to pick it up quickly, plus familiarity with the broader landscape of agent/tool standards

  • Strong Python and experience building and deploying backend services and APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or similar)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex, or open-weight models via vLLM/Ollama)

  • Working knowledge of RAG: embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar), and retrieval evaluation

  • Comfort with prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON mode, schemas), and tool/function calling

  • Experience writing evals — even lightweight ones — for non-deterministic systems

  • Solid SQL and experience with relational and unstructured data

  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

  • Git, code review, and modern collaborative workflows

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain AI tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience authoring MCP servers for non-trivial systems (databases, internal APIs, document stores)

  • Experience with eval and observability platforms (Braintrust, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or custom harnesses)

  • Multi-agent orchestration patterns and experience reasoning about agent failure modes

  • Fine-tuning, distillation, or LoRA experience where it actually moved the needle

  • Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD for AI workloads

  • TypeScript/Node for full-stack AI features

  • Streaming UIs (SSE, WebSockets) and token-level UX patterns

  • Experience with caching, prompt compression, and cost/latency optimization at scale

  • Background supporting federal or government clients

  • Awareness of NIST AI RMF, FedRAMP, or related responsible-AI frameworks

Requirements

  • Must be a US Citizen or legal resident, able to work domestically

  • Must be able to attain a low-level security clearance

  • Must work from the United States

Perks

  • Work from anywhere.
  • The chance to work on high-visibility projects and make a significant impact.
  • Competitive salary range ($130,000 - $200,000+) based on role requirements and your experience and impact.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
  • Up to 20+ days of PTO annually.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan.
  • FSA/HSA and commuter benefit options.
  • Professional development opportunities, certifications, and continuous learning support.
  • Company-provided technology and access to productivity and AI tools.
  • Additional bonus based on performance.

Get to know us

    We're a small, creative, highly technical team. Our heroes are the scrappy folks who dare to dream and do great things. We care more about doing the right thing than taking shortcuts. We finish projects. We surprise our clients with how much we genuinely care about their success. We're selective about our partners — and our people. We don't say "human resource" because you're not a resource. You're a teammate, and we'll treat you like one.

What you should expect from us

  • We will treat you fairly

  • We give you space to grow personally and professionally

  • We will hear your ideas even when we disagree

  • We will be honest about our challenges and equitable with our success

  • We will tell you the truth, even when it's difficult

What to Expect in Our Hiring Process

    Our hiring process typically consists of 3 interview stages, after an initial screening. For engineering roles, the process may include additional technical assessments depending on the position's requirements. We aim to make the process straightforward and respectful of your time.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Due to the nature of our work with the federal government, all roles at BLEN are required to work from the contiguous United States.

title: Head of Content - Talent Pool
description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Head of Content! 🌟

Are you passionate about telecoms? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customer’s most trusted advisor for cloud-based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

What will you be doing?

Own and personally run Babble's content operating system - the core knowledge behind everything we publish, the AI-powered tools built on it, and everything that depends on them being right.

Our content is built on the They Ask, You Answer approach - sometimes called the Endless Customer method: answering the real, specific questions our customers and prospects are actually asking, clearly and honestly, rather than producing generic marketing copy. Done well, this is what earns Babble its reputation as a trusted adviser to the small and medium-sized businesses we work with, not just another technology vendor.

Content is produced through this operating system with the help of AI, but editorial judgement is what makes it good - and it matters most at the two ends of the process: shaping the brief and the standards the AI tools work from at the start, and personally checking, correcting, and approving what comes out at the end. We call this being the human in the loop, and it's the core of the role, not an occasional check.

There is currently one other person in the content function. This role works alongside them day to day and is the final quality check on everything that goes out under Babble's name.

Accountabilities and Deliverables:

  • Own our core body of knowledge - clear, honest answers to the real questions our customers and prospects ask about cost, problems, comparisons, and what good looks like - and keep it accurate and current.
  • Decide where to go deep and where to go light - prioritising the products and topics that matter most to our customers, rather than treating everything as equally important.
  • Direct our AI-powered content tools day to day - shaping the brief and standards they work from at the start, and personally checking and correcting what they produce before anything is published.
  • Make sure everything we publish is properly organised and easy to find - both for people searching our site and for AI tools like ChatGPT or Google's AI answers.
  • Make sure every campaign and every piece of content, whoever produces it, draws on the same accurate, approved information - so Babble never says two different things about the same product.
  • Reference pricing and product facts from Babble's single source of truth, rather than restating them independently in content.
  • Work day to day alongside the one other person currently in the content function, setting the standard both work to, while remaining personally hands-on rather than only directing.
  • Report on content performance in plain terms the CMO can act on.

Core Competencies:

  • Skilled at turning technical or scattered knowledge into a clear answer a customer would genuinely want to read.
  • Editorial judgement - able to prioritise, and to explain and defend that judgement to stakeholders.
  • Comfortable being the human in the loop - giving clear direction up front and catching what AI gets wrong at the end, every time, without exception.
  • Practical, organised thinker who can define and stick to a simple, consistent structure.
  • Comfortable being the person who sends something back if it doesn't meet the standard, regardless of who wrote it.
  • Discipline and attention to detail.
  • Owner-operator mindset - does the work personally as well as setting the bar for others' output.
  • Comfortable with data - reads it and adjusts the plan, not just reports the numbers.

Key Performance Indicators

  • How fully and clearly we answer the real questions our customers and prospects ask.
  • Whether Babble's content is being found and cited by AI search tools (like ChatGPT or Google's AI answers) when people look for answers.
  • Growth in people choosing to follow Babble's content directly, rather than us having to chase attention.
  • How often our own sales and account teams choose to share the content with customers themselves - a real test of whether it's trusted, not just produced.
  • Strong content or editorial background in a B2B environment - proven ability to define what a business says, not just write it well.
  • Familiarity with the They Ask, You Answer (Endless Customer) approach to content is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent, precise written English is essential - this role produces content that represents Babble publicly, and the standard of written English will be closely assessed.
  • Experience using AI tools in a disciplined, consistent way to produce genuinely high-quality, on-brand content - not generic, unchecked AI output. Experience with agentic AI specifically is a bonus, not a requirement, given how new that technology still is.
  • Comfortable working alongside one other person day to day, setting a shared standard rather than working in isolation.
  • Experience maintaining consistency and quality across content produced by multiple contributors.
  • Confident holding a quality standard and pushing back on stakeholders, including senior ones, when content doesn't meet the bar.

Why work for Babble?

  • Risk cover; covering Life Cover, Critical Illness Cover, funeral benefits and some Disability benefits
  • 22 days holiday Balance PLUS UK Bank Holidays - with increased annual leave based on length of service
  • 5% allowance based on basic salary that can be towards Medical Aid.
  • UPS provided to assist with load shedding (2-4hrs power for a laptop)
  • Babble issued laptop
  • Annual Company Celebrations

Home-Working Policy

  • Your location will be home based, and you will require stable internet connection.
  • It will be your responsibility to have a solution in place to mitigate loadshedding to ensure you are able to work your normal shifts effectively, working from a public space is not deemed a acceptable solution.
  • As a home worker we expect you to have a suitable work set up, desk and a chair in a quiet space.

The recruitment journey

We want to fill this role quickly, but we want to get the right person. The recruitment process will consist of a screening call. If you proceed past this then you will have an interview over Teams and possibly a follow up interview and competency testing depending on the role requirements.

Direct Candidates Only

Babble is a Customer Experience-led growth business. As the ultimate Trusted Advisor for cloud-based technologies, we specialize in empowering businesses with the best solutions from the world's leading providers.

With thousands of customers, we're just scratching the surface of our potential. Many of our clients currently benefit from one or two of our technologies, presenting an incredible opportunity to introduce them to our full suite of market-leading solutions.

description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

Join the pioneering Servicing International team at the forefront of Affirm's global expansion, building the foundational platform to launch our products into a new generation of international markets. This role will focus on two critical parts of the user journey: purchase protection, including disputes and refunds, and agent tooling, which is essential for our agents to offer the best support possible to our customers—both significant areas of investment to ensure trust and satisfaction for our newest customers. The team collaborates closely with European engineering counterparts and engineers across our global Servicing Engineering organization to build cohesive, scalable solutions, and you'll play an active part in that. If you are passionate about creating world-class user experiences and excited by the challenge of launching products in new regions, join us. What you’ll do

What we look for

  • You have previous work or internship experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
  • You have previous work or internship designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

location: Ocala, Florida, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 11 Aug 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.

Our Neuromodulation Operating Unit provides advanced therapies for chronic pain, movement disorders, and other neurological conditions. Through therapies such as spinal cord stimulation and targeted drug delivery systems, we deliver personalized treatments that restore function, reduce symptoms, and improve quality of life worldwide.

Our key Pain Therapies include: Spinal Cord Stimulation, Drug infusion for Chronic Pain / Drug infusion for severe Spasticity, and RF Nerve Ablation.

Check us out on LinkedIn: Pain Interventions

At Medtronic, the Associate Clinical Specialist, supports the Neuromodulation Pain, Target Drug Delivery and Interventional Therapies in the areas of surgical coverage, follow-up support, troubleshooting, customer service and education. This person will be engaged in basic market development activities depending upon the needs of the assigned territory and district.

This is a field based role.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Represents Medtronic during surgical procedures by ensuring all necessary equipment and products required are available, providing technical support and device selection, and performing programming and testing of all device systems

  • Manages patients through all phases of the clinical process as well as educate them on the features and benefits of Medtronic products

  • Provides clinical support in surgeries, re-programmings, trouble-shooting and follow ups in hospitals and clinics

  • Responds promptly and appropriately to technical inquiries by customers, patients, and colleagues

  • Maintains a working knowledge of competitive products

  • Educates and trains physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on products and therapies. This is expected by, but not limited to, coordinating one on one teaching sessions, formal in-services, education programs, seminars and/or outside symposia (based off quarterly Plan of Action as directed by Leadership)

  • Assists Management and Sales Training department in education/training of new employees in the district

  • Complies with required event reporting and documentation utilizing Medtronic technology tools

  • Accountable for placing orders with customer service for pending purchase orders and product replacement

  • Expected to work with materials management to collect POs for cases covered within the territory/district

  • Responsible for managing inventory provided for case coverage, including: timely transactions when product is used, sold or transferred, maintaining a required level of cycle count accuracy, executing product retrievals as instructed, turning over inventory in a reasonable time frame, not implanting expired product or product that is on hold

  • Contributes to the achievement of quarterly goals associated with specific initiatives at the district, regional and/or national level

  • Partners with sales representatives to achieve business goals set forth within the territory/district and documents quarterly activities utilizing provided business tool(s)

  • Visits accounts to replenish literature and establishes/maintains relationships with office staff

  • Effectively utilizes Excel, a mobile phone, an IPAD, a laptop, and/or a Samsung tablet regularly

  • Manages business expenses and budget effectively and in given timeframe

  • Ensures personal understanding of all quality policy/system items that are personally applicable

  • Completes all new hire therapy trainings as directed by medical education

  • Ability to be flexible with schedule while working and/or attending clinical events, possibly outside of normal business hours to include weekends and after hours and at the discretion of Clinical Specialist Manager

  • Travels to cover district cases as needed in the district, and occasionally to other districts at the discretion of Clinical Manager

We are committed to building a workforce that brings together a broad range of perspectives and experiences at every level. This approach fuels innovation and helps us remain an industry leader—that’s why we focus on attracting and developing employees who are patient-centric, passionate, and deeply connected to the needs of the patients we serve.

To learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at Medtronic, click here.

Qualifications

Must Have: Minimum Requirements

To be considered for this role, please ensure these minimum requirements are evident on your applicant profile.

  • A High School Diploma or GED with a minimum 4 years of clinical or medical sales experience; or An Associate Degree with a minimum 2 years of clinical or medical sales experience; or A Bachelor’s degree

Nice to Have: Preferences

  • Live in the territory of Ocala, FL

  • Bachelor's degree in a health care related field

  • Registered nurse or HCP with experience in a sterile environment

  • Clinical experience with implantable neurological products and patient care

  • Experience in servicing medical personnel on product use

  • Experience with a medical device or pharmaceutical company, and clinical experience in a specialty area: neurology, neurosurgery, orthopedic, operating room, pain management, or home health care

  • Understanding of basic reimbursement and healthcare environment

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Required to function using healthcare universal precautions to minimize exposure to infectious disease and radiation

  • Ability to serve as the primary resource for scheduled and unscheduled clinical events, periodically required to work weekends, evenings and nights and may be required to engage in overnight travel within own district or neighboring districts

  • Ability to work efficiently and autonomously with little direction when outside of clinical events

  • Ability to attend national meetings, district meetings and other training as requested

  • Ability to wear a 7-9 lbs protective lead apron for extended periods of time in the operating room

  • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs

  • Ability to sitting, standing, and/or walking for 8+ hours per day

  • Ability to bend/stoop, squat and balance frequently

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus in relation to travel and operating a personal computer.

**Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy. In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

description:
About DGR Systems
DGR Systems is an IT service provider founded to help companies get the most out of their business technology investments. Over the years, we have helped many businesses implement transformational IT solutions so that they can concentrate on growing their businesses and realizing their goals.

We understand that having the right people on our team is what differentiates us and we focus our efforts on ensuring that all team members share a common set of core values designed to foster a productive and enjoyable work environment. We are committed to providing a positive, inclusive work experience that supports our team with training, development, and coaching to allow them to achieve their personal growth objectives.

Description

DGR Systems, a growing premier technology consulting company, is looking for an Engineer with expertise in Identity and Access Management(AIM) solutions.

This individual will be responsible for delivering identity-focused projects, assessments, and operational improvements while supporting senior engineers and architects on larger engagements. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a passion for learning, and a customer-first mindset.

The successful candidate will work closely with customers and internal teams to implement, support, and optimize identity solutions that improve security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Identity Solutions Delivery

  • Implement and support identity and access management solutions for customer environments.
  • Independently deliver smaller projects, assessments, health checks, and remediation engagements.
  • Support medium and large projects under the guidance of Senior Engineers and Architects.
  • Participate in customer workshops, discovery sessions, and project meetings.

Demonstrate Expertise

  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Active Directory
  • Hybrid Identity
  • Entra Connect Sync and Cloud Sync
  • Okta Workforce Identity
  • Single Sign-On (SSO)
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
  • Conditional Access
  • Identity Governance
  • Lifecycle Management
  • Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Identity Security Best Practices
  • Zero Trust Principles

Assessments and Health Checks

  • Conduct identity assessments and health checks.
  • Document findings and recommendations.
  • Assist with remediation planning and implementation activities.

Implementation and Support

  • Configure and deploy identity solutions.
  • Perform migrations, upgrades, and tenant integrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Support testing, validation, and knowledge transfer activities.

Documentation

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, and customer deliverables.
  • Ensure project activities and outcomes are accurately documented.

Professional Development

  • Pursue ongoing training and certification opportunities.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives within the practice.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in the IT industry with experience supporting identity and access management technologies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory environments.
  • Exposure to Okta or other enterprise identity platforms preferred.
  • Experience implementing or supporting MFA, SSO, Conditional Access, and identity-related technologies.
  • Experience with PowerShell or other automation technologies preferred.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Demonstrated customer service and consultative skills.

Benefits

Why DGR?

DGR Systems helps solve the most complex business and operational challenges for their customers. Our team of top-level industry experts takes an innovative and straightforward approach to consulting, design, deployment, and ongoing Assurance Services to meet customer needs.

At a glance, DGR Systems was founded in 2009 in Tampa, Florida, and provides full-service solutions in the areas of Modern Workplace (Endpoint Solutions, Collaboration), Security (Identity and Access Management, Zero Trust, Information Protection) Modern Infrastructure and Cloud, and Applications (Collaboration Apps, SQL Reporting, Power Platform). With an impressive depth of experience across the Microsoft technology solution stack combined with our focus on integrating solutions from multiple leading vendors, we help organizations design and execute against their most challenging digital transformations. At DGR Systems, our culture is built around one simple standard: Excellence is our Baseline - and we deliver on that standard with every customer, every day.

Core Values

DGR Systems core values are an essential and enduring tenant of our organization. They are a small set of timeless guiding principles describing who we are, how we treat people and how we run our business.

  • Passion - Love what you do and make it evident through your approach to your work and the attitude you display.
  • Ownership -Be accountable for outcomes. Take initiative to start and move things forward to make something better.
  • Integrity -Do the right thing. Always. Every time. Without exception.
  • Navigation - Find solutions to problems. Evolve, adapt, and embrace change around you for tomorrow will be different than today.
  • Teamwork - Be approachable and engage with the team around you constantly. We win or lose together.

Full-Time Team Member Benefits

DGR Systems is committed to the health and welfare of our team members. This commitment involves offering a comprehensive benefits program to help prepare team members and their family for planned as well as unplanned life events.

  • Group Health Care Plans (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Company Paid Life Insurance (Basic & AD&D)
  • Company Paid Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Company Paid Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Voluntary Insurance Options (Voluntary Life, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance)
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Work From Home Program
  • Wellness Resources

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, weare not able tosponsor visas.

title: Junior Commercial Litigation Barrister or Solicitor (Consultant)
description:
Junior Commercial Litigation Barrister or Solicitor (Consultant)

We are looking for a junior Commercial Litigation Barrister or Solicitor to join Harper James on a flexible, freelance consultancy basis.

This is an excellent opportunity to support a growing and diverse client base, ranging from innovative start-ups and scale-ups to established national and international businesses. You will assist our litigation team with the preparation and progression of court proceedings within a modern, tech-enabled law firm.

Working as part of our flexible consultant model, you will have the autonomy to manage agreed workstreams while benefiting from the support, infrastructure and collaborative culture of a forward-thinking national firm.

What you’ll be doing

You will support senior members of the Commercial Litigation team with the preparation, management and conduct of court litigation.

The role will suit an organised and detail-focused lawyer who is confident handling procedural work, drafting, evidence preparation and case administration to a high standard.

Your work is likely to include:

  • Assisting with the preparation and drafting of statements of case, applications, witness statements, chronologies and other court documents

  • Conducting legal and factual research to support live disputes and litigation strategy

  • Reviewing, organising and analysing documentary evidence

  • Preparing trial bundles, hearing bundles and electronic bundles in accordance with court requirements

  • Assisting with disclosure exercises, including document review, categorisation and preparation of disclosure lists

  • Drafting correspondence with clients, opponents, counsel, courts and other relevant parties

  • Preparing case summaries, attendance notes, hearing notes and internal updates

  • Supporting the preparation of applications, hearings, mediations and trials

  • Assisting with the management of court deadlines, procedural timetables and case management requirements

  • Liaising with clients to obtain instructions, documents and witness evidence

  • Supporting senior solicitors and barristers with the efficient day-to-day management of litigation matters

You may also have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across the wider Harper James legal team where disputes intersect with corporate, commercial, employment, intellectual property, real estate or insolvency matters.

What we’re looking for

A UK qualified Barrister or Solicitor with experience in commercial litigation and court procedure.

  • Junior-level experience, with the confidence to assist on active litigation matters under appropriate supervision

  • Strong knowledge of the Civil Procedure Rules and practical experience of litigation processes

  • Experience preparing court documents, bundles, chronologies and evidence

  • Excellent legal research, drafting and analytical skills

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly in relation to procedural requirements and document management

  • Ability to work efficiently, independently and flexibly while managing competing priorities

  • Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

  • A pragmatic, client-focused approach and an interest in supporting ambitious businesses through dispute resolution

  • Experience working with electronic disclosure, e-bundling or litigation technology would be advantageous

The Harper James difference

We are a tech-driven, agile law firm where lawyers are empowered with modern legal technology to maximise efficiency, productivity and work-life balance. Our consultant model offers flexibility, autonomy and the ability to work remotely, while remaining part of a supportive national team.

At Harper James, we keep things straightforward. We are relaxed and informal but well organised.

There are no politics and no big egos, if people around us succeed, so do we. We welcome proactive, self-motivated lawyers who thrive in a modern legal environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional client service.

The bottom line

This is an opportunity to play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our Commercial Litigation team, working alongside experienced colleagues and a great team of people who all contribute to our shared success.

Flexible working within a fully remote but collaborative team. Ad hoc attendance at our office in the centre of Birmingham is likely from time-to-time depending on work requirements.

We are offering a competitive consultancy rate, with flexibility and autonomy as part of the Harper James consultant model.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE

title: Senior Director, Revenue Analytics
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Senior Director, Revenue Analytics, you'll lead a high-performing team of analytics professionals and own the strategic vision and execution for sales and customer experience data and analytics across GitLab. You'll serve as a key business partner to executive leadership, using data to shape GitLab's go-to-market strategy, customer experience, and revenue growth throughout the customer lifecycle.

This role combines strategic thinking with operational excellence. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy, Customer Success, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Enterprise Data & Analytics to deliver insights that drive business outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the Revenue Analytics team, setting analytics standards and building scalable capabilities to support GitLab's growth.
  • Support AI self-serve initiatives within the Field through certified data sets, coordination with Ent Data on semantic layers and metric definitions.
  • Lead a team building insights via AI tooling and solutions along with legacy BI solutions.
  • Own the analytics roadmap across sales, customer success, and professional services to improve sales productivity, retention, services utilization, and revenue performance.
  • Develop and support forecasting, pipeline, capacity, and predictive models to improve forecast accuracy, conversion, velocity, resource allocation, and revenue planning.
  • Build customer lifecycle analytics for onboarding, product adoption, engagement, churn risk, expansion, NRR, and GRR to improve customer outcomes.
  • Provide strategic leadership on the metrics, insights, and data necessary to help the GTM functions migrate to a consumption-based business model.
  • Create executive artifacts to be used on recurring basis, integrated reporting, attribution models, and strategic analyses that connect acquisition, post-sale, and services performance.
  • Partner with executive leaders and teams across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product, Professional Services, and Enterprise Data & Analytics to turn business questions into clear recommendations.
  • Establish data governance and reporting frameworks that improve data quality and provide reliable insights for executive, board, and external reporting.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience leading analytics teams and developing team members in sales, customer, revenue operations, business intelligence, or consulting environments.
  • Knowledge of business-to-business software-as-a-service business models, sales processes, and revenue metrics across the customer lifecycle.
  • Experience with consumption-based metrics and business models.
  • Ability to develop strategic analytics roadmaps, translate complex data into clear insights, and influence executive-level decisions.
  • Experience with customer success analytics, including health scoring, churn prediction, NRR and GRR analysis, segmentation, and expansion analytics.
  • Experience with sales and professional services analytics, including forecasting, revenue planning, utilization, project profitability, and services-led growth metrics.
  • Ability to work with large, complex datasets to develop analytical frameworks that inform resource allocation, capacity planning, and customer outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Business Intelligence tools (Tableau, Hex, Omni), Structured Query Language (SQL), data modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling for customer analytics.
  • Familiarity with customer data platforms, product analytics tools such as Gainsight or Pendo, services management systems, and other business intelligence platforms is a plus.

About the team

The Revenue Analytics team are full-stack analytics business partners who work with stakeholders to turn data into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions. Members of this team are able to take questions and needs from leadership and create solutions based on analytic engineering, understanding data structure best practices, business intelligence and data visualization work, ad hoc analytics, project management, and AI implementation. They work to define the best solutions by providing the right data in the right format at the right time in a platform agnostic manner. In this role, you'll shape how we operate, develop our capabilities, and ensure our work supports measurable business outcomes.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

title: API Solutions Architect
description:
API Solutions Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: API Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale. The ideal candidate brings hands-on architectural leadership across complex transformations, with a clear point of view on when microservices are the right answer, how to evolve them safely, and how to keep the resulting estate maintainable over the long term.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and decomposition strategies aligned with domain-driven design principles.
  • Lead the modernization of legacy monoliths into well-bounded, independently deployable services with clear ownership.
  • Design service communication patterns leveraging REST, gRPC, asynchronous messaging, and event streaming as appropriate. Establish API contracts, schema governance, and versioning strategies that enable safe evolution of services over time.
  • Architect resilient distributed systems incorporating circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, and graceful degradation patterns.
  • Define data ownership models, transactional boundaries, and patterns such as outbox, saga, and CQRS where appropriate.
  • Lead the design of platform capabilities including service mesh, API gateway, identity propagation, and shared observability.
  • Drive performance engineering, capacity planning, and scalability analysis across critical service domains.
  • Establish CI/CD, testing, and deployment standards optimized for high-frequency, low-risk service releases.
  • Define observability standards including structured logging, distributed tracing, and SLO-driven monitoring.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure zero-trust principles, secrets management, and runtime protection are embedded.
  • Mentor engineers and tech leads on microservices best practices and anti-pattern avoidance.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on service design proposals across multiple teams.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging cloud-native technologies for adoption based on maturity and strategic fit.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Eight or more years of software engineering experience, with several years in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise in microservices design, domain-driven design, and distributed systems patterns.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and service mesh technologies.
  • Proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, or C#.
  • Strong understanding of API design, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous messaging.
  • Experience operating high-traffic, latency-sensitive systems in production.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms and managed services across at least one major provider.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead architecture initiatives spanning multiple teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platform construction.
  • Familiarity with Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, or comparable service mesh technologies.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization at scale.
  • Public speaking, open-source contributions, or published technical writing.
  • Experience in regulated industries with strict compliance requirements.

title: Experience Strategy and Transformation Principal
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Experience Strategy & Transformation Principal for Group Specialty Products is a senior role within the Product Delivery organization, accountable for shaping, aligning, and accelerating end-to-end product experiences across Group Specialty lines of business. This role partners closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and Business leaders to ensure that product strategies, delivery roadmaps, and operating models are grounded in a clear business architecture and deliver measurable value to customers, brokers, and internal stakeholders.

The Experience Strategy & Transformation Principal brings deep expertise in experience-led transformation, product operating models, and enterprise business architecture to guide complex, cross-product initiatives. This role influences outcomes across multiple portfolios by translating business strategy into coherent product capabilities, value streams, and delivery execution.

Key Responsibilities

Experience & Product Strategy

  • Lead experience strategy and transformation initiatives across Group Specialty products, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals, customer needs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Product Management and Product Delivery leaders to define experience-driven product strategies, outcomes, and success metrics.
  • Champion a consistent, scalable approach to experience design across Group Specialty offerings, balancing innovation with operational feasibility.
  • Collaborate and work directly with Director, AVP, and VP level leaders across business and IT

Product Delivery Alignment

  • Embed experience strategy into the Product Delivery lifecycle, influencing intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, and execution.
  • Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure initiatives are structured around clear customer journeys and measurable outcomes.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to Product Owners, Delivery Leads, and Program leaders on complex, multi-year initiatives.

Business Architecture & Capability Modeling

  • Define and maintain business capability models for Group Specialty products, ensuring clarity on what the business does today and what capabilities are required for future-state strategies.
  • Define and maintain 3-5 year strategic roadmap for Group Specialty
  • Map customer and operational experiences to underlying business capabilities, value streams, and enabling technologies.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Technology teams to ensure business architecture informs solution design, sequencing, and investment decisions.
  • Identify capability gaps, redundancies, and dependencies across products to inform roadmap decisions and transformation priorities.

Transformation Leadership

  • Lead experience and operating model transformations that span multiple products, functions, or platforms.
  • Advise senior leaders on trade-offs, sequencing, and change impacts related to experience, delivery, and architecture decisions.
  • Be a subject matter expert on experience strategy, product operating models, and business architecture best practices.

Executive Influence & Governance

  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to senior executives on initiatives of significant scope and complexity.
  • Support portfolio-level governance by ensuring initiatives align to defined capabilities, value streams, and strategic outcomes.
  • Communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's or Doctorate preferred in Business, Technology, Design, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in product strategy, experience transformation, product delivery, or enterprise transformation roles.
  • Demonstrated experience working within Product Delivery or Agile product organizations at scale.
  • Strong background in business architecture, including capability modeling, value streams, and experience-to-capability alignment.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority and operate effectively as a senior individual contributor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or regulated industries strongly preferred; Group or Specialty products.

title: Director of Marketing Technology (Multi-Solution Architect)
description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a Director of Marketing Technology to serve as a senior, consultative Multi-Solution Architect within our Digital Experience Platforms practice. This role is designed for a seasoned marketing technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with strong client advisory skills, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, architecting solutions, and contributing directly in a billable capacity across client engagements.

While Adobe Experience Cloud represents a dominant ecosystem within the Bounteous practice, this role is intentionally multi-platform. The Director is expected to bring strong Adobe expertise alongside working knowledge of complementary marketing technology platforms and patterns, including CRM, CDP, marketing automation, analytics, and personalization technologies. The role spans both B2B and B2C use cases, with an emphasis on data-driven orchestration, lifecycle marketing, and measurable business outcomes rather than CMS- or DAM-centric implementations.

This position serves as a bridge between sales and delivery, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and platform partners while also setting delivery teams up for success. The Director balances strategic leadership with hands-on, billable client work, helping clients modernize their marketing technology ecosystems and extract long-term value from their platform investments.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role and Responsibilities:

    Multi-Solution Architecture and Strategy

    • Serve as a senior, consultative marketing technology architect across multiple platforms and solutions
    • Lead the design of scalable, data-driven marketing technology architectures that support both B2B and B2C customer journeys.
    • Architect solutions spanning CDP, marketing automation, journey orchestration, analytics, personalization, and CRM integrations.
    • Provide architectural guidance across dominant Adobe platforms as well as complementary technologies where appropriate.
    • Translate business objectives into platform architectures, data models, integration patterns, and activation strategies.
    • Maintain awareness of evolving MarTech capabilities, ecosystem trends, and emerging technologies.

      • Client Advisory and Billable Delivery

      • Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to client stakeholders, guiding platform selection, roadmap planning, and architectural tradeoffs.
      • Maintain an active billable role across client engagements, contributing directly to discovery, solutioning, and delivery oversight.
      • Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, demos, and executive presentations.
      • Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural intent and best practices.
      • Support escalation, troubleshooting, and course correction on complex marketing technology programs.

        • Pre-Sales, Growth, and Partnerships

        • Partner with client service and business development teams to support pursuits, pitches, and account expansion.
        • Support pre-sales solutioning through consultative discovery, estimates, and solution narratives.
        • Identify opportunities to create packaged offerings, accelerators, and repeatable solution patterns
        • Collaborate with platform partners, including Adobe and other MarTech vendors, on roadmap awareness, co-innovation, and solution alignment.

          • Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

          • Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
          • Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.
          • Provide thought leadership in the marketing technology space, helping position Bounteous as a trusted partner for enterprise MarTech transformation.
          • Mentor architects and senior practitioners, contributing to internal enablement, frameworks, and best-practice playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications

    • 10 or more years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering marketing technology solutions.
    • 3 or more years of experience in a digital-first, global delivery agency or consultancy.
    • Deep experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, including platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Customer Journey Analytics, and related tools.
    • Working knowledge of non-Adobe MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or similar, with the ability to architect across ecosystems.
    • Strong understanding of CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, and data integration patterns.
    • Proven ability to operate in a consultative, client-facing role while maintaining billable delivery responsibilities.
    • Demonstrated success translating complex technical ecosystems into measurable business outcomes.
    • Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: SEM M&V Lead
description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.

POSITION SUMMARY

WE ARE SEEKING A SENIOR STRATEGIC ENERGY MANAGEMENT (SEM) STATISTICAL ANALYST TO LEAD ADVANCED MEASUREMENT & VERIFICATION (M&V) FOR COMMERCIAL AND INSTITUTIONAL BUILDINGS. THIS ROLE REQUIRES A STRONG UNDERSTANDING OF BUILDING SYSTEMS, ENERGY USE PATTERNS, AND HOW THESE FACTORS INFLUENCE WHOLE BUILDING REGRESSION MODELS. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE COMBINES TECHNICAL DEPTH IN ENERGY ANALYTICS WITH PRACTICAL KNOWLEDGE OF BUILDING OPERATIONS TO DRIVE ACCURACY, CONSISTENCY, AND INNOVATION IN OUR M&V PROCESSES.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

MODEL DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS: DESIGN, IMPLEMENT, AND VALIDATE WHOLE-BUILDING REGRESSION MODELS FOR SEM PROGRAM M&V. ANALYZE ENERGY CONSUMPTION DATA IN THE CONTEXT OF BUILDING SYSTEMS AND OPERATIONAL PATTERNS TO QUANTIFY SAVINGS AND PERFORMANCE IMPACTS. PERFORM PRE- AND POST-MODELING DATA REVIEW AND MANIPULATION TO ENSURE ACCURACY AND CONSISTENCY IN ENERGY MODELING EFFORTS. ASSIST WITH ADVANCED STATISTICAL ANALYSIS AND BENCHMARKING REPORTING TO PROVIDE ACTIONABLE INSIGHTS TO SEM TEAMS.

QUALITY ASSURANCE & BEST PRACTICES: ESTABLISH AND MAINTAIN QC PROTOCOLS FOR SEM MODELING AND REPORTING. DEVELOP STANDARDIZED METHODOLOGIES ALIGNED WITH INDUSTRY BEST PRACTICES AND REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS. HELP DEVELOP AND MAINTAIN STANDARDIZED TEMPLATES FOR ENERGY MODELING AND PROGRAM DATA TO ENSURE EFFICIENT WORKFLOWS ACROSS ALL SEM PROGRAMS.

TRAINING & KNOWLEDGE SHARING: PROVIDE TRAINING AND GUIDANCE TO INTERNAL TEAMS ON SEM MODELING TECHNIQUES AND INTERPRETATION OF RESULTS. SERVE AS A SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT FOR STATISTICAL ANALYSIS, BUILDING ENERGY SYSTEMS, AND M&V PROCESSES.

COLLABORATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: MONITOR EMERGING TRENDS AND TOOLS IN SEM AND M&V ANALYTICS. RECOMMEND ENHANCEMENTS TO IMPROVE ACCURACY, EFFICIENCY, AND SCALABILITY OF METHODS AND PROCESSES. COLLABORATE WITH PROGRAM MANAGERS, MODELERS, PROGRAM PARTICIPANTS TO RESOLVE TECHNICAL ISSUES AND IMPROVE PROCESSES. WORK CLOSELY WITH INTERNAL TEAMS AND OCCASIONALLY INTERACT WITH CLIENTS TO GATHER DATA AND CLARIFY REQUIREMENTS.

INDUSTRY STANDARDS, BEST PRACTICES, AND DOCUMENTATION: MAINTAIN UP-TO-DATE KNOWLEDGE OF SEM AND M&V POLICIES, BUILDING TECHNOLOGIES, AND ENERGY EFFICIENCY STANDARDS. MAINTAIN CLEAR DOCUMENTATION FOR MODELING PROCESSES AND TEMPLATES TO SUPPORT CONSISTENCY AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years in energy efficiency, SEM programs, or related analytics roles.
  • Proven experience with M&V methods and protocols (ASHRAE 14, IPMVP, ISO 50001, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate building system knowledge into statistical modeling.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including complex formulas and Visual Basic; familiarity with Power BI, SQL, Julia, and Python is a plus.
  • Proficiency in statistical software (R, Python, SAS, or similar).
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail, particularly when working with large datasets.
  • Strong understanding of regression modeling, uncertainty analysis, and time-series data.
  • Familiarity with building energy systems (HVAC, lighting, plug loads, controls) and their impacts on energy use patterns.
  • Excellent communication and training abilities.
  • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with utility programs and regulatory requirements preferred.
  • Experience working in SEM program frameworks preferred.
  • Committed to diversity and inclusion.
  • Reliable transportation.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Certification: AEE Certified Measurement & Verification Professional – (CMVP) preferred.

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel up to 5%

Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their care team, which includes board certified physicians, advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.
