title: Senior Security Research Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Reporting to the Director of Global Vulnerability Management, you will serve as a Senior Security Research Engineer and technical lead within SIE’s Global Vulnerability Management team. You will lead complex work that advances our Threat Exposure Management capability and supports our transition to a Continuous Threat Exposure Management operating model, while remaining directly engaged in vulnerability research, analysis, security validation, prioritization, and remediation support.

You will partner across Information Security, engineering, technology, and business teams to improve how SIE discovers, prioritizes, validates, and mobilizes action on security risks. You will translate annual TEM goals into defined workstreams, delivery plans, success measures, and repeatable operating practices that improve visibility, decision-making, remediation outcomes, and program scale.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex Global Vulnerability Management workstreams that advance SIE’s Threat Exposure Management capability and transition toward a Continuous Threat Exposure Management operating model across discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization.
  • Translate annual TEM goals into defined delivery plans, milestones, success measures, dependencies, and repeatable operating practices. Monitor progress, identify barriers, and adjust execution to improve outcomes.
  • Lead hands-on vulnerability research and technical analysis to confirm security conditions, eliminate false positives, characterize exploitability and business impact, and provide actionable remediation or mitigation guidance.
  • Improve the discovery and assessment of vulnerabilities across SIE network, cloud, endpoint, application, container, and other technology environments.
  • Develop risk-based prioritization using vulnerability and threat intelligence, exploitation evidence, asset and business context, control effectiveness, and remediation considerations.
  • Lead security validation activities and develop proofs of concept when appropriate to distinguish material risk, evaluate defensive controls, and support informed decisions.
  • Partner with Information Security teams and technology owners to mobilize remediation, clarify ownership, establish effective handoffs, resolve barriers, and measure progress through remediation, mitigation, or accepted disposition.
  • Evolve GVM platforms, integrations, data, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled workflows to improve coverage, data quality, consistency, decision speed, and operational scale.
  • Communicate vulnerability trends, material risks, remediation progress, and program outcomes to technical, operational, and leadership audiences through clear reports and recommendations.
  • Mentor engineers and partner teams, contribute to technical standards and procedures, and improve the quality of vulnerability analysis, validation, documentation, and delivery.
  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques, threat activity, security technologies, and industry practices.
  • Some travel may be required.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in information security, information technology, systems engineering, or a related field, including substantial experience in vulnerability management, security research, or exposure management.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in computer science, information security, or a related discipline.
  • Experience leading complex technical workstreams across multiple teams, translating objectives into delivery plans, and achieving measurable outcomes without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability research, technical analysis, security validation, risk-based prioritization, and remediation or mitigation guidance.
  • Experience assessing vulnerabilities across several technology domains, such as operating systems, networks, cloud services, applications, endpoints, containers, databases, or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience with vulnerability discovery, assessment, validation, or exposure-management platforms and their supporting integrations.
  • Knowledge of adversarial tactics, exploitation techniques, threat intelligence, and attack frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, with the ability to apply that information to vulnerability prioritization.
  • Experience using scripting, programming, APIs, or automation to improve security analysis and operational workflows. Relevant technologies may include Python, SQL, Bash, PowerShell, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
  • Experience analyzing and contextualizing security data to connect technical findings with asset, service, business, threat, control, and remediation information.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices such as version control, testing, code review, CI/CD, reusable components, and controlled production releases.
  • Ability to communicate complex security conditions, priorities, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical, operational, and leadership audiences.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or analysts and influencing technical practices across teams.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience helping evolve a traditional vulnerability-management function toward a TEM or CTEM operating model.
  • Experience with continuous security validation, adversarial exposure validation, exploit research, or proof-of-concept development.
  • Experience securing cloud, container, application, or build-pipeline environments and integrating security capabilities into engineering workflows.
  • Experience with security-data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Domo, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience applying automation, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled capabilities to vulnerability analysis, prioritization, validation, or remediation workflows.

title: Senior Product Manager, Lodging Shopping
description:
About Engine

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we’re here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That’s why we’re building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

Your Mission

As part of the Engine team, you'll help drive the lodging shopping experience, obsessing over how customers search, evaluate, and book. This is a role for someone who thinks like a consumer product builder and wants to bring that bar to B2B travel. You'll live in the details of the search results page, the property details page, and everything that happens between "I need a place to stay" and "booked." Here's what you'll take charge of:

  • Drive the shopping experience roadmap: Shape how customers discover and evaluate lodging on Engine, from search results to property details to the moments that convert browsers into bookers.
  • Own conversion and retention: Move the metrics that matter. Run experiments across the funnel, learn fast, and compound wins into a shopping experience that keeps customers coming back.
  • Make lodging shopping consumer grade: Raise the bar on the map, filters, page layout, and the first time booker experience so that shopping on Engine feels as good as the best consumer travel products.
  • Partner across product, design, and engineering: Work closely with cross functional teams to prioritize the right bets, ship quickly, and hold a high bar for craft.

What You'll Bring to Engine

We're looking for someone ready to make a real impact on one of the most visible parts of Engine:

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in product management, with a strong track record of shipping and iterating on shopping funnels. B2C background is a strong plus, especially if you've brought a consumer grade bar to a product. Travel experience is not required.
  • Experimentation chops: You've run a lot of experiments and know how to design them well. You're comfortable operating in a test and learn environment, reading data critically, and knowing when to trust a result versus when to dig deeper.
  • Consumer grade instincts: You have taste. You notice the small things that make a shopping experience feel great or feel off, and you push your team to close the gap.
  • Judgment: You have conviction and aren't a pushover. You can tell an engineer or a stakeholder "no" and explain why, and you help make hard prioritization calls and stand behind them.
  • Presence and agency: You show up as a peer to strong design, engineering, and commercial partners. You don't hide behind "the team thinks." You take accountability for your part of decisions and outcomes.

Applications for this role will be accepted through 11/5/2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$153,935—$213,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & CompensationWe believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with opportunities for bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at.
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we’ll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more.

Ready to Build the Future of Work Travel?Join us on our mission to transform how work travel works—for businesses, for travelers, and for the industry. Apply now and let’s make travel simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable—together.

title: Supervisor Payer Enrollment & Reporting
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

This position functions in a complex payer credentialing environment with changing health care rules, regulations and laws under the leadership of the Director of Professional Services. This position oversees all aspects of the centralized payer reporting and enrollment processes, including facility and provider onboarding, revalidations and delegated reporting oversight for approximately 13 Hospitals and over 2,600 physicians and allied health practitioners for Health Partners Network, Inc. (PHO), Integrated Health System and West Virginia United Health Systems. Interfaces with the HPN/WVUIS Manager, Professional Services, Director, Professional Services and VP, Payer Strategy & Contracting as well as hiring Recruiters, Managers, Administrators and VPs to provide and interpret relevant data enabling identification of facilities and practitioners who may or may not meet the standards required for enrollment with payers. Extensive knowledge in the area of the Director of Professional Services’ area(s) of administrative responsibility is required in order to relieve superior of certain responsibilities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. High School Diploma or GED required

EXPERIENCE:

1. Five years in managed care, physician’s office practice or credentialing office

2. Seven years of health care industry experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelor’s Degree preferred

EXPERIENCE:

1. Two years of supervisory experience

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Supervises enrollment and reporting staff and carries our supervisory responsibilities that may include but are not limited to: interviewing, hiring, firing, counseling, disciplinary actions, annual performance reviews, training, planning, assigning and directing work, addressing complaints and resolving problems. Must make sound business decisions while maintaining sensitivity to staff needs and concerns.

2. Assist with the development of productivity standards for staff. Assist with the development of reports to track staff productivity. Evaluate and redistribute workload of staff members when necessary to ensure maximum productivity.

3. Assist in development of processes and work flows to ensure timely completion of facility/provider enrollments and payer reporting.

4. Supervise the work flows and operations of the enrollment staff in completing, submitting and tracking of facility and provider applications for West Virginia United Health System while ensuring timely follow-up.

5. Advises the Director of Professional Services of any problems or perceived problems with providers enrollment applications, facilities applications or breakdowns in the application process flows. Then notifies hiring administrator and/or VP as appropriate.

6. Demonstrates expertise in understanding of NCQA, TJC, CMS and state regulations as it relates to the enrollment processes.

7. Research and analysis of current enrollment requirements to ensure of all documentation is submitted in compliance with policies, regulatory requirements and accreditation standards.

8. Responsible for the maintenance and integrity of the credentials data base and works closely with IT and our software vendor to resolve issues.

9. Oversee the creation and preparation of reports including, but not limited to: HPN rosters, ASO reports, monthly provider profiles/rosters, weekly staff meeting reports, etc.

10. Supervise the work flows and operations of the payer reporting staff in creating, submitting and tracking monthly system wide enrolled provider reports for compliance and revenue cycle operations for West Virginia United Health System.

11. Ensures payer reporting compliance for more than 20 payers who have delegated credentialing to West Virginia University Hospitals Inc., West Virginia United Insurance Services Inc. and Health Partners Network, Inc.

12. Develop and maintain service benchmarks and quality improvement programs.

13.Communicates with payers to resolve authorization and billing denials related to the facility and/or provider(s) not being loaded as participating.

14. Consistently ensures a customer service orientation with regard to requests, customer problems, complaints, suggestions, etc., follows through with and/or resolves while presenting an image of professionalism.

15. Actively seeks to promote and helps maintain interactions with others inside and outside the organization in a positive, professional, team-oriented, and service-conscious environment which contributes to the goals of the organization and reflects the values of the System.

16. Works effectively, confidently and pro-actively with others in the Department, Medical Staff Leaders, Hospital Administrators, Office Managers, Billing Managers and other personnel and customers.

17. Nurtures an atmosphere of collaboration and team oriented interpersonal relationships, communication flow and information sharing between departments

18. Demonstrates a respect for the human dignity of all individuals (employees, physicians, peers, volunteers, customers, visitors, etc.); helps to create and maintain team work within the work environment; practices good negotiation skills for resolving conflicts under time pressures and deadline commitments

19. Maintains proper attendance and punctuality to ensure continuity in the functions of the position.

20. Maintains a high level of confidentiality in all aspects of the position

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Standard office environment.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Ability to work extended hours as needed.

2. Analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

3. Ability to function in a demanding and fast paced environment.

4. Possess excellent organizational and prioritization skills and have the ability to work on several projects simultaneously.

5. Ability to carry out a range of functions: organize, delegate, direct, and review the work of others; maintain an effective work pace under deadlines; learn and apply pertinent statutory provisions, rules, regulations, policies, procedures; read and understand manuals and other detailed books of instruction; create action plans for special projects; and manage the implementation process through completion.

6. Proficient computer skills, thorough knowledge and understanding of office software programs including Windows, MS Office, Excel, Outlook and ability to create, update and run reports in the credentialing database (ECHO) or similar applications.

7. Knowledge of URAC, NCQA, and TJC(if applicable) standards

8. Possess excellent communication skills in order to communicate with influential internal and external contacts.

title: Process and Implementation Lead (Internal Only)
description:
About You

Our people represent our Values to our customers; to be successful at Ashbury you will naturally be:

  • Welcoming: friendly, approachable and open to new ideas, feedback and improvement
  • Positive: create a positive experience for our people and our clients
  • Confident: act with integrity from a strong foundation of expertise
  • Simplicity: you will remove complexity and bring clarity

Role Purpose

The Service Process Implementation Specialist translates Ashbury’s client service processes into clear, build‑ready requirements for IT, ensuring that technical developments are implemented effectively, consistently and in a way that improves efficiency and profitability.
This role combines deep operational understanding with the ability to articulate requirements clearly to technical teams.

Key Accountabilities

  • Map, document and standardise end‑to‑end service delivery processes across clients.
  • Translate operational processes into clear functional requirements for IT, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
  • Work closely with IT to ensure solutions reflect real‑world service delivery needs and operational constraints.
  • Lead UAT for all process‑related IT releases, ensuring issues are identified and resolved before deployment.
  • Test, validate and embed new tools, workflows and automations into service delivery teams.
  • Maintain a central library of process maps, SOPs and workflow documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise or automate processes to improve efficiency and profitability.
  • Provide subject‑matter insight on how services are delivered today and how they should evolve.
  • Support the Process & Commercial Improvement Manager with data, insight and implementation detail.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Ashbury’s client service delivery processes.
  • Ability to translate operational workflows into clear, structured requirements.
  • Experience working with IT or technical teams on workflow or system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (SOPs, process maps, functional requirements).
  • Experience in UAT, testing or implementation of new tools.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify simplification and automation opportunities.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non‑technical audiences.

Distinctiveness of the Role

This role is the translator and implementer.

Success Measures

  • High‑quality, accurate functional requirements delivered to IT.
  • Successful UAT cycles with minimal post‑release issues.
  • Adoption and embedding of new tools and workflows across teams.
  • Reduction in process variation and improved standardisation.
  • Clear, accessible and up‑to‑date process documentation library.

Benefits

  • Home based role*
  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays as standard*
  • Additional annual leave depending on length of service
  • Option to buy or sell additional annual leave
  • Charity day and time off to support your favourite charity
  • Payroll Charity giving scheme
  • Cycle to Work scheme and much more!

title: B2B Proposal Storyteller & Writer
description:
The connected device category is in one of its most consequential moments in years — and Assurant Global Connected Living is helping shape what comes next.

We partner with many of the world's leading brands, supporting millions of customers across connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment. Our purpose is simple: help people thrive in a connected world. As mobile, retail, OEM, and smart home ecosystems converge, customer experience, lifecycle economics, and brand trust are colliding in real time — and every proposal we win is a chance to prove what Assurant can do.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a B2B Proposal Storyteller & Writer who can find the through-line in complex business and technical information, translate it into a compelling business narrative, and make our value unmistakable to the clients making high-stakes decisions. This is a role for a writer who is rigorous, curious, and energized by work that directly shapes how Assurant competes and wins.

What Makes You Successful

  • You think critically and lead with business acumen. You don’t just capture information — you interrogate it, find the insight others miss, and connect it to what actually moves a deal or a client relationship forward.

  • You’re a bold storyteller. You have a point of view, you’re willing to make a confident recommendation, and you can turn complex, technical material into a narrative that’s persuasive and impossible to ignore.

  • You build relationships across the organization. You lead with high EQ, read the room, and earn trust with sales, product, legal, and SMEs — so people want to bring you their best thinking.

  • You’re collaborative without losing your edge. You balance diverse perspectives and healthy debate, then synthesize them into one clear, differentiated position.

  • You bring rigor to the craft. Attention to detail, deadline discipline, and version-control instincts are second nature — because in this role, precision is part of the persuasion.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this role?

Authoring persuasive business proposals & related materials

  • Review complex and detailed RFPs and work with the larger team to formulate the appropriate response “plan of attack”.

  • Contribute to and socialize RFP briefs that guide responses, key messages, and differentiators.

  • Translate complex products, services, technical capabilities, and detailed RFP line items into clear, concise, and persuasive client-friendly messaging that facilitates discussion and sharpens our responses.

  • Partner closely with sales, product, legal, and subject matter experts to gather inputs and shape differentiated responses.

  • Respond to RFP questions with compelling, well-positioned answers that support technical knowledge and differentiation.

  • Develop high-impact sales materials including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, cover letters, and executive summaries that synthesize technical RFP responses into a compelling, high-level narrative that supports Assurant’s win strategies.

  • Tailor content to specific industries, client segments, and buyer personas to increase relevance and conversion.

  • Work with SMEs to ensure that their ideas and vision are captured and expressed appropriately.

Continuous optimization of sales enablement content

  • Continuously improve a centralized content library of reusable responses, case studies, and proof points.

  • Create supporting content that may take the form of long- and short-form website content, as well as ad copy, video scripts, associate talking points and sales materials.

Proposal coordination and stakeholder management

  • In conjunction with the proposal coordinator, manage feedback, revisions, and document versions in a fast-paced team environment.

  • Edit and revise written content based on feedback and business requirements.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in B2B content strategy, proposal writing, sales enablement, marketing communications, or a related field; experience in consumer electronics, mobile, retail, or technology industries is preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, Communications, Journalism, or a related field preferred.

  • Proven writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex business and technical information into clear, persuasive content for executive, partner, and customer audiences.

  • Experience developing proposals, RFP responses, presentations, sales collateral, case studies, thought leadership, and other customer-facing content.

  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to partner across Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Subject Matter Experts to create winning content.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with a creative problem-solving mindset and openness to feedback and continuous improvement.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Technical fluency; comfortable using standard web-based tools typical of remote work environments.

  • Understands the balance between “perfection” and “flawed-but-adequate”, and knows how and when to prioritize one over the other.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager

Are you a highly organized Technical Project Manager ready to take the next step in your career? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where you can create structure, align engineering and business teams, and drive technical initiatives that make a measurable impact? If so, Codekeeper could be the right place for you.

We're searching for a proactive, hands-on professional who takes ownership and actively contributes to the successful planning, coordination, and execution of technical projects across teams. Our ideal candidate is eager to grow within the industry, comfortable working at the intersection of engineering and operations, and ready to roll up their sleeves to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the highest standard. If you're driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.

We're accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.

Role Description

As a Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing technical projects and ensuring they are successfully delivered with strong results and real impact. Your work will include planning, coordinating, researching, organizing, and driving projects that bridge engineering, product, and business goals. Thriving in our dynamic, fast-paced environment requires not only monitoring progress but actively engaging in every stage of the project lifecycle—from initial scoping through execution and continuous improvement. Within our fast-moving environment, there is always something happening, offering plenty of opportunities to step in, take ownership, and make a meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Innovate and Navigate: Lead technical projects from inception to completion, breathing life into project ideas with your structured planning and pragmatic execution. Transform technical requirements into tangible successes, leveraging your unique blend of technical understanding and analytical skills.
  • Guide and Achieve: Monitor the heartbeat of project progress with an eagle eye, setting ambitious yet attainable deadlines. Your leadership will ensure projects not only stay on track but also sprint toward their goals, exceeding expectations.
  • Communicate and Collaborate: Act as the pivotal bridge between engineering teams and department heads, translating technical detail into clear business language. Your adept communication skills will foster an environment of clarity and cooperation, driving collective success.
  • Resolve and Propel: Embrace technical and organizational challenges with a problem-solving mindset, navigating through obstacles with agility. Your capacity to identify solutions and make decisive actions will keep projects advancing, even against the odds.
  • Deliver Excellence: Cross the finish line with projects that not only meet the brief but also set new standards of excellence. Your commitment to quality and results will not just complete tasks but will carve out new benchmarks for success.

More about Codekeeper

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art disaster recovery solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues
  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth
  • Regular team activities and gatherings
  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period
  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback
  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

What We Are Looking For

  • Proficiency in utilizing contemporary web tools and technologies such as Zapier, Linear, Google Docs, etc.
  • Prior experience in technical project management, or in software/product delivery with an emphasis on problem-solving.
  • Enough technical fluency to work comfortably with developers—understanding workflows, dependencies, and trade-offs (no coding required).
  • A proactive doer who's eager to actively participate and tackle challenges head-on.

Additional Requirements

  • Proficiency in English, covering both written and verbal communication
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and analytical thinking. A preference for pragmatism over idealism.
  • Ability to adapt, to manage various tasks and able to prioritize

Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote (
  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!

How to Apply

Please send an application that speaks directly to how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company's future and our role in yours. Address some of the work we do. Introduce yourself as a colleague. Feel free to respond in either Dutch or English.

title: GMD DevSecOps Engineer
description:
GMD DevSecOps Engineer

Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time
Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher
Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance or higher required


Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking an experienced, team-oriented GMD DevSecOps Engineer to support the Ground-based Midcourse Defense (GMD) mission in Huntsville, Alabama. In this role, you will provide critical support to the GMD Digital Acquisition & Infrastructure team and will be primarily responsible for architecting, building, and scaling the DevSecOps environment within the Integrated Digital Data Environment (IDDE).


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect and provision the IDDE DevSecOps environment using Terraform to ensure scalable, repeatable, and version-controlled infrastructure deployments.
  • Deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications and microservices using Kubernetes, ensuring high availability and resilience for mission-critical workloads.
  • Design, implement, and maintain advanced continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software building, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Serve as a system administrator within the IDDE across hybrid cloud environments, including AWS and Azure. Manage tool deployment, infrastructure configuration, Windows Active Directory, and user account management.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity engineers to execute STIG evaluation, analysis, and implementation. Embed automated security and code-scanning tools directly into CI/CD pipelines to maintain high software security standards.
  • Support deliverable and release objectives, develop comprehensive product and infrastructure documentation, and manage complex deployment orchestration.


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree with 12+ years of relevant experience or bachelor’s degree with 20+ years of relevant experience.
  • Active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for complex Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Proficiency in building, deploying, and managing containerized environments using Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
  • Hands-on operational experience within enterprise cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Proven experience with Windows Server administration, Windows Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), and System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM).
  • Demonstrated experience with STIG analysis, deployment orchestration, and security/code-scanning tools.
  • Experience with Integrated Development Environments such as Coder.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Cloud Certifications: Active professional-level cloud certifications are highly preferred, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Container Certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).
  • Advanced familiarity with GitLab for code repositories, pipeline execution, and backlog management.


Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity.


We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.


Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.


About Created Solutions

Founded in 2024 in Huntsville, AL, Created Solutions is a fast-growing small business delivering advanced engineering solutions to the DoD and NASA. We provide expert government support services in flight vehicle design, electrical and mechanical systems, material science, manufacturing, and hypersonic technologies—helping solve some of the nation’s most complex and critical defense challenges.


Join us and be part of a team where purpose and excellence come together.

title: Senior Scientist, Synthetic Data Generation
description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the AI revolution, and our research is shaping the future of large language models. We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our team and help advance our capabilities in synthetic data generation for training frontier models. You will contribute to open-source libraries within the NVIDIA NeMo ecosystem that generate synthetic datasets across text, code, structured, and multimodal data, directly feeding the pre- and post-training of LLMs such as Nemotron. This role combines hands-on software engineering with applied research in generative methods, and you will collaborate with research, engineering, product, and model teams as well as external labs.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build synthetic data generation pipelines using LLM-based methods and automated quality evaluation, producing datasets that improve the pre- and post-training of LLMs such as Nemotron — reasoning, coding, structured output, and multimodal understanding.

  • Advance multimodal synthetic data generation — image, document, video, and audio — in partnership with NVIDIA's model teams.

  • Design and maintain open-source libraries and SDKs with clean APIs and strong documentation.

  • Drive software excellence with modern tooling, architecture based on configuration, and professional Git/CI-CD.

  • Publish original research at top machine learning and AI conferences to maintain NVIDIA's technical leadership.

  • Mentor interns and junior researchers to develop technical growth within the team.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A research background of 3+ years in synthetic data generation, generative modeling, multimodal machine learning, or related areas. Comparable experience is also considered.

  • Deep technical understanding of LLMs, how data shapes their pre- and post-training, and inference frameworks such as vLLM or TGI.

  • Proven track record of developing or maintaining software libraries used by a broad developer community.

  • Strong publication record at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or similar.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Open-source contributions in ML or data tooling.

  • Experience with multimodal generation or understanding (vision-language, document AI, video, or audio).

  • Building and optimizing scalable data pipelines for large-scale model training (throughput, distributed inference).

  • Experience generating data for agentic, tool-use, or reinforcement-learning post-training.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working with us. If you are creative, autonomous, and passionate about building open-source tools that make AI safer and more private, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 3, and 192,000 USD - 304,750 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 10, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior MBSE Systems Engineer
description:
Senior MBSE Systems Engineer

Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Level: Senior Level
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM field
Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance required


Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior MBSE Systems Engineer to support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Chief Engineer in transforming the agency’s approach to systems engineering. In this role, you will apply Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies and tools to help advance MDA from traditional document-driven engineering toward an integrated, model-based engineering environment.

The ideal candidate brings strong model-based engineering experience, familiarity with MBSE tools, and an interest in helping shape how MDA approaches future engineering efforts.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Assist in capturing and developing new system models that will serve as a foundation for future MDA engineering efforts.
  • Apply a variety of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methodologies to support engineering activities.
  • Coordinate with internal and external teams to develop, integrate, and collaborate on system models.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field.
  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Strong Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience.
  • Experience with interface or interoperability engineering domains.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Expertise with MBSE tools and technologies such as SysML, Cameo, MathWorks Simulink, MATLAB, Visio, and ModelCenter.
  • Previous Missile Defense Agency (MDA) experience.
  • Expertise in Command and Control (C2), data transport, Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT), and/or interoperability.


Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity.


We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.


Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.


About Created Solutions

Founded in 2024 in Huntsville, AL, Created Solutions is a fast-growing small business delivering advanced engineering solutions to the DoD and NASA. We provide expert government support services in flight vehicle design, electrical and mechanical systems, material science, manufacturing, and hypersonic technologies—helping solve some of the nation’s most complex and critical defense challenges.


Join us and be part of a team where purpose and excellence come together.

Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity.


We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.


Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

title: Head of Training and Education
description:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cyera is building a Training and Education function from the ground up — the team that teaches customers and partners how to get full value from the platform. This is a founding leadership role: you will design the strategy, build and lead the team, and select the technology stack needed to run a modern customer education function.

Educated customers renew more, escalate less, and adopt faster. This role will build external-facing training, education, and certification programs — for customers and channel partners — that scale adoption as the customer base grows and give certified partners the credibility to deliver and support implementations independently.

You will report to the Chief Customer Officer and partner closely with Product Management, Channel & Partnerships, Support, and Finance to build a function that is credible, measurable, and fundable.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy & Program Ownership

  • Own the training and education strategy end-to-end, spanning pre-engagement onboarding, admin fundamentals, hands-on labs, certification, and partner accreditation.
  • Define and defend the program's ROI model — onboarding readiness, skill validation, support-ticket reduction, product adoption, and partner quality — and report outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Prioritize investment by impact, balancing low-effort, high-value initiatives against deeper, longer-term capabilities.

Curriculum & Learning Experience

  • Direct the design of self-service learning paths, instructor-led (VILT/ILT) training, and hands-on lab curricula for customer admins, operators, and partner engineers.
  • Establish a governance model that keeps the curriculum current as the product evolves, informed by real-world adoption and support signals.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly scale the program — localization, adaptive learning paths, and an AI tutor — while keeping subject-matter-expert review as the source of truth.

Certification & Partner Training

  • Build a role-based certification program (e.g., Certified Platform Admin) with defensible, proctored exams.
  • Design the partner certification pathway — learn, practice, validate, authorize, monitor — so accredited partners can deliver and support implementations independently.

Team & Vendor Management

  • Hire, lead, and grow the Training and Education team, building a full function of instructional designers, trainers, lab engineers, a curriculum manager, and certification specialists.
  • Own the technology stack and vendor relationships across the LMS, content authoring, hands-on lab platform, exam delivery, and digital badging — negotiating contracts and managing budget.

Analytics & Executive Reporting

  • Stand up and continuously evolve an outcomes dashboard covering training completion, lab completion, certified users, trained-vs-untrained support volume, and onboarding readiness.
  • Represent the function in front of the CCO and cross-functional leadership, translating program activity into business impact.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years leading customer-facing training, education, or certification programs - building or scaling an external learning organization - ideally at a B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure company.
  • Track record owning a P&L or budget for a training/education function, including vendor selection and contract negotiation (LMS, authoring platforms, lab environments, exam proctoring).
  • Experience designing certification and partner accreditation programs that gate independent delivery on demonstrated competency, not just course completion.
  • Comfort operating at both altitudes - setting strategy for executive stakeholders while staying close to the mechanics of certification exams, lab environments, and the learning platform.
  • People leadership experience, including hiring and developing instructional designers, trainers, and lab engineers.
  • Fluency measuring training outcomes - completion, certification pass rates, support deflection, adoption - rather than just tracking content delivered.
  • A background in product management, or in a security/data-focused product function, is a strong plus, given the technical depth required to build credible, technically rigorous certification standards.

title: Senior POS Mobile Engineer
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

As a Senior Mobile Engineer (POS Terminal), you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining high-performance Android-based POS applications used across large-scale transaction environments.

You will work closely with Mobile Architects, Backend Engineers, Product Managers, and Hardware teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable POS features. This role requires strong hands-on Android expertise, deep understanding of payment flows, and experience integrating with POS hardware and EMV standards.

You will own complex features end-to-end while contributing to system design discussions and ensuring engineering excellence across the codebase.

What you’ll get to do

  • Feature Development & Ownership

    • Design, implement, and maintain Android-based POS terminal applications (Java/Kotlin).
    • Own end-to-end development of key transaction flows (sales, refunds, reversals, settlement).
    • Collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure reliable transaction synchronization.
    • Implement offline-first capabilities and manage edge-case handling in low-connectivity environments.

  • Payments & Security

    • Integrate EMV chip, contactless (NFC), and card-present transaction flows.
    • Work with encryption standards, key management processes, and secure payment SDKs.
    • Ensure compliance with payment security best practices.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve transaction-related issues in production

  • Hardware Integration

    • Integrate and maintain support for POS peripherals (card readers, pin pads, printers, scanners).
    • Work with OEM SDKs for Android-based POS terminals.
    • Handle Bluetooth, USB, and embedded hardware communication layers.

  • Code Quality & Engineering Standards

    • Write clean, maintainable, testable code following established architecture patterns.
    • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
    • Contribute to improving CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
    • Support debugging, monitoring, and performance optimization efforts.

  • Collaboration & Mentorship

    • Work cross-functionally with Product, QA, and Backend teams to deliver high-quality features.
    • Mentor mid-level engineers and support onboarding of new team members.
    • Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and technical discussions.

To succeed in this role, you should have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in Android app development
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject
  • Strong expertise in Android Native development (Kotlin/Java).
  • Experience building or maintaining POS terminal applications.
  • Solid understanding of EMV standards and card-present transaction flows
  • Experience integrating payment SDKs and hardware peripherals.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, WebSockets, and background sync mechanisms.
  • Experience with local storage solutions (Room, SQLite).
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices in financial systems.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.
  • Experience working in fintech or high-transaction environments.
  • Exposure to cross-platform frameworks (e.g., Flutter).
  • Experience working with Android-based embedded POS terminals.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A take-home test exercise
  • A technical interview with a Lead in our Engineering Team
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

Moniepoint is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Backend Engineer (Data Platforms)
description:
About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Back-End Engineer (Data Platforms)to help build the next generation of IXOPAY's AI Payments Intelligence platform.

In this role, you'll design and develop the backend services and data infrastructure that power AI-driven insights, analytics, and payment optimization. Working closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams, you'll build scalable systems that help enterprise merchants improve payment performance, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions using their payment data.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both technical architecture and product direction.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services for our AI Payments Intelligence platform.

  • Develop data pipelines, ETL processes, and cloud-native infrastructure that process large volumes of payment transaction data.

  • Build the backend services that power analytics, dashboards, AI-driven insights, and customer-facing reporting.

  • Collaborate with enterprise customers to integrate payment data from PSPs, acquirers, and other external systems.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to design new platform capabilities and contribute to architectural decisions.

  • Develop secure, reliable APIs and integration services for payment gateways, reporting APIs, webhooks, and other data sources.

  • Optimize backend systems for performance, scalability, security, and high availability.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute to engineering best practices across the platform.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, data engineering, or database development.

  • Strong Python development experience building scalable backend applications and data processing systems.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services, including S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito, SQS, and related cloud technologies.

  • Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and cloud-native architectures.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a collaborative, agile environment.

  • Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Experience with payment data analytics, payment gateways, PSP integrations, or FinTech platforms.

  • Experience with analytical databases such as ClickHouse or Snowflake.

  • Experience building AI or machine learning infrastructure and supporting analytics platforms.

  • Previous experience working in a startup or high-growth technology company.

Location

This is a remote-friendly position. We welcome applications from candidates based in Germany or Italy, with a preference for those located in or near Munich. You'll have the flexibility to work remotely or from our Munich office.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help build the data infrastructure and backend services powering the next generation of enterprise payments. You'll work on complex engineering challenges involving AI, large-scale payment data, and cloud-native technologies while collaborating with experienced engineers and product teams in a fast-growing international company.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Professional growth and development opportunities

  • A collaborative, international engineering culture

  • Flexible remote working with the option to work from home or our Munich office if based in Germany

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY. What Makes an IXOPAYer? We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IXOPAY is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

IXOPAY participates in E-Verify.

title: Missile Defense System Architecture Engineer
description:
Missile Defense System Architecture Engineer

Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Level: Senior Level
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM field
Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance required; ability to obtain TS/SCI required


Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking an experienced Missile Defense System Architecture Engineer to support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) in Huntsville, Alabama. In this role, you will lead and participate in analyses of current and future Missile Defense System (MDS) architectures and concepts, as well as modeling and simulation (M&S) tool development to support MDS architecture assessment.

This position is ideal for an engineer with a strong understanding of missile defense architectures who can apply modeling, simulation, and technical analysis to evaluate future capabilities and identify solutions to evolving mission challenges.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Assess Missile Defense System capability gaps, challenges, needs, and opportunities against current and future threats to develop potential architecture solutions that mitigate gaps and improve system performance.
  • Assist in developing analysis plans and execute MDS simulation tools using DoD High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems.
  • Assess analysis results, prepare technical briefs and reports, and review analysis products.
  • Support modeling and simulation (M&S) efforts by tailoring tools to specific analysis plans and architecture assessment needs.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field with 7+ years of relevant experience in missile defense or another complex, large-scale DoD program or project.
  • Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret/SCI clearance.
  • Solid understanding of current Missile Defense System architecture and future concepts.
  • Experience modeling, assessing, and evaluating future missile defense architectures.
  • Experience with MATLAB.


Desired Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret/SCI clearance.

title: Security & Trust Manager
description:
Description

We're looking for a Security and Trust Manager to own Reco's customer-facing security and compliance program while also supporting our internal security operations. This is a high-impact individual contributor role sitting at the intersection of customer trust, GRC, enterprise security, and identity and access management.

On the external side, you'll be the face of Reco security to enterprise customers: owning security questionnaires, audits, and compliance assurance that unblock revenue and build lasting trust. On the internal side, you'll assist enterprise security programs and identity and access controls that protect Reco's own environment. This dual mandate puts you in a unique position: you'll use Reco's own platform to manage the SaaS access risks you're simultaneously explaining to customers.

Responsibilities

Customer Trust and GRC

  • Own Reco's customer trust operations end-to-end: intake, triage, prioritization, and completion of security questionnaires, vendor risk assessments, and RFIs.
  • Serve as the primary security point of contact in enterprise sales cycles; removing security blockers and accelerating deal velocity.
  • Build and maintain Reco's Trust Center and compliance artifacts: SOC 2 evidence, ISO 27001 documentation, security whitepapers, and customer-facing one-pagers.
  • Lead customer-facing security meetings, audits, and diligence calls with technical depth and credibility.
  • Manage and mature Reco's GRC program: frameworks, risk assessments, control monitoring, and audit readiness across SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and applicable regulations.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Legal to translate customer security requirements into internal roadmap inputs.
  • Respond to questions across compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and sector-specific requirements.
  • Drive process improvements: build reusable response libraries, automate questionnaire workflows, and improve SLA performance.

Enterprise Security

  • Support Reco's internal enterprise security posture: endpoint security, MDM, security awareness training, and security policy management.
  • Maintain and improve Reco's internal security policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Contribute to vendor and third-party risk management, ensuring Reco's supply chain meets our own security bar.

Identity and Access Management

  • Partner with IT and Engineering to maintain role-based access controls, audit trails, and access certification processes.
  • Use Reco's own platform to discover, monitor, and remediate identity and SaaS access risks internally.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security trust, GRC, compliance, or customer-facing security roles at SaaS or cloud companies.
  • Hands-on experience completing enterprise security questionnaires, RFIs, and leading customer security reviews.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and common compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (ISO 42001, EU AI Act).
  • Experience with IAM tools and concepts: SSO (Okta, Azure AD, or equivalent), SCIM provisioning, access reviews, and privilege management.
  • Strong technical foundation: cloud security (AWS, GCP, or Azure), application security, data protection, and access controls.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication -- able to translate complex security topics for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Experience with GRC and trust automation tools (Vanta, Drata, SafeBase, Conveyor, or similar).
  • Collaborative, cross-functional mindset -- comfortable working alongside Sales, Legal, Engineering, and Product.

title: Controller
description:
About Engine

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we’re here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That’s why we’re building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

About the Role:

Engine is a high-growth, multi-entity travel marketplace with multiple revenue streams, international operations, a company-branded charge card, and a disciplined 5-day close. Accounting here already runs lean and AI-forward.

We are hiring a Controller to take it to the next level of excellence, building on the automation and AI already in place and scaling a modern close through Engine’s next phase of growth.

This is not a maintenance role. We are looking for a decisive, high-judgment leader who can raise talent density, simplify how work gets done, and push our existing AI and automation further to create real operating leverage. The goal is not to build a larger function. It is to build a better one.

You will report to the VP, Accounting and lead the core Accounting leadership team, including Assistant Controller / GL, AR and, Payroll, and Tax. The role has a meaningful runway to grow into broader scope as Engine grows.

Your Mission

Own the operating system of Engine’s accounting function: the talent bar, the integrity of the close, the control environment, and the pace of automation, so a lean team scales with the business without scaling headcount.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Raise the operating bar: Create a clearer, more accountable operating model across Accounting. Clarify decision rights, push ownership closer to the work, reduce unnecessary escalation, and move priorities quickly from discussion to execution.
  • Increase talent density: Build a high-performing leadership team that operates with strong judgment and increasing independence. Set a clear performance bar, develop strong managers, address capability gaps directly, and make thoughtful talent upgrades where needed.
  • Scale AI and automation: Build on the automation and AI already in place across Accounting and take it further. Partner with Systems and cross-functional teams to automate high-volume and repetitive work, apply AI to reconciliations, documentation, anomaly detection, and management visibility, and ensure headcount grows slower than transaction volume and business complexity.
  • Modernize the close: Take an already-disciplined 5-day close and make it cleaner, faster, and less manual. Strengthen ownership across revenue, AR, payroll, tax, consolidations, reconciliations, and reporting. Remove recurring friction, simplify review layers, and fix root causes.
  • Make decisions at speed: Serve as a senior decision-maker across complex accounting and operational issues. Make well-reasoned calls with imperfect information, document the rationale, and keep the organization moving. Bring strong technical accounting depth without allowing complexity to become a reason for delay.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Create clarity where ownership is fragmented, surface tradeoffs, make recommendations, and drive work to resolution across Product, Finance, Tax, Legal, Credit, Fraud, Sales, People, and Systems.
  • Prepare Accounting for the next phase: Build the leadership depth, systems, processes, and controls required to support increasing transaction volume, new revenue streams, international expansion, card receivables, rewards, supplier economics, intercompany activity, and FX. Anticipate where today’s processes will break at tomorrow’s scale and address those constraints early.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive accounting leadership, including Controller, Assistant Controller, or equivalent responsibility in a high-growth environment. CPA strongly preferred.
  • Track Record: A history of improving an established accounting function, not just maintaining one.
  • Talent Leadership: Proven ability to act as a talent magnet, improving the talent bar, developing the team, and building leadership depth.
  • Automation & AI: An AI-native, automation-forward operating style, with demonstrated success reducing manual work and creating measurable operating leverage.
  • Technical Accounting: Strong multi-entity close, consolidation, reconciliation, and financial statement experience, with depth across ASC 606 (gross-versus-net and principal-agent analysis), ASC 842, ASC 718, reserves, and other judgment-heavy areas.
  • Judgment & Pace: Strong judgment and decisive pace; comfortable making calls with incomplete information and operating strategically while staying close to execution.

Nice to Have:

  • Travel, marketplace, fintech, payments, card-program, or high-volume transaction accounting experience.
  • Card receivables, rewards, supplier economics, merchant and agency models, or complex revenue streams.
  • International experience, including intercompany, FX, VAT/GST, transfer-pricing support, or statutory reporting.
  • NetSuite and modern close, reconciliation, workflow, BI, automation, and AI tools.

What Success Looks Like:

Within the first 6 to 12 months:

  • The close is less dependent on manual intervention.
  • Automation and AI improvements are tied to measurable capacity, accuracy, and cycle-time gains.
  • Cross-functional issues move to resolution faster.
  • The function absorbs greater complexity without proportional headcount growth.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$199,000—$260,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & CompensationWe believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with opportunities for bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at.
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we’ll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more.

Ready to Build the Future of Work Travel?Join us on our mission to transform how work travel works—for businesses, for travelers, and for the industry. Apply now and let’s make travel simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable—together.

This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads.
